# Content Hashing for IR Payloads

This module provides the capability to compute a deterministic hash of a dictionary payload, by converting it to canonical JSON and applying a SHA-256 hash. This is used to uniquely and consistently identify information in Envelopes within the intermediate representation (IR) of the knowledge compiler.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/ir.py` — `knowledge_compiler.ir.content_hash`
